gameName: Slay the Spire: The Board Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Slay the Spire: The Board Game rulebook (via the RulesPal transcription; refs are rulebook section names)

steps.text: Each player picks a character: player board, mini, starter deck, card rewards deck and rare rewards deck
steps.note: Ironclad and Silent are easiest; Watcher is hardest

steps.text: Cubes on your board: Energy {energy}, Block 0, HP at the highest printed number
Shuffle the Act I Encounter, Elite and Event decks; shuffle the "1st Encounter!" cards separately
Act I Summons in a pile - don't shuffle
Shuffle the Relic, Potion, Boss Relic and Curse decks; Daze and Status piles unshuffled
steps.note: Ascension cards stay locked until unlocked

steps.text: Act I board with a random Act I map
Map tokens facedown: dark on dark spaces, light on light; then flip them faceup
Random Act I Boss (roll the die) facedown on the Boss icon
Boot meeple at the bottom of the map; character minis on the lowest open space
Player Aid board within reach (Merchant on the back)
Each player draws a Neow's Blessing: gain the red reward, choose 1 of the 3 blue
Solo: also take the Gold and the Loaded Die relic
Status and Daze cards leave your deck after each combat
Next Act: swap in that Act's decks and board, heal to full, reshuffle card rewards (not rares)
Set up the 1st Encounter and start combat
